name: Yehliu, Jiufen & Shifen Sky Lantern Day Tour
tag: Klook's Best Seller No.1 · A Must-Visit Classic
desc: The top pick among international visitors! Stroll past Yehliu's Queen's Head, the red-lantern mountain town of Jiufen, and release a blessing sky lantern at Shifen.

name: Hualien Taroko Gorge & Qingshui Cliff Day Tour
desc: Marvel at Swallow Grotto, the Tunnel of Nine Turns, Eternal Spring Shrine, and Qingshui Cliff rising vertically above the Pacific.

name: Sun Moon Lake & Qingjing Skywalk & Gaomei Wetland Day Tour
enName: Sun Moon Lake, Cingjing & Gaomei Tour
tag: Alpine Grassland · Lake & Mountain Views · Sunset
desc: Three of central Taiwan's top sights in one trip! Cruise Sun Moon Lake, stroll among Qingjing's sheep, and watch the sunset over the windmills at Gaomei Wetland.

name: Alishan Forest Railway Train & Giant Trees Day Tour
enName: Alishan Forest Railway & Giant Trees Tour
tag: World Heritage Mountain Railway · Millennia-Old Cypress
desc: Journey through a sea of clouds! Ride a century-old train and breathe in the forest air among 2,000-year-old giant trees and the natural wonder of Sisters' Pond.

name: Tainan Historic City & Sicao Green Tunnel Charter Day Tour
enName: Tainan Heritage & Sicao Green Tunnel Tour
tag: Taiwan's Mini Amazon · Tainan Food Walk
desc: Drift through a stunning mangrove green tunnel on a raft, then explore Anping Fort, Chihkan Tower, and the famous beef soup on Guohua Street.

name: Kenting National Park & Eluanbi Southernmost Point Charter Day Tour
desc: Head straight to the southern tip from Kaohsiung! Visit Sail Rock, Shadao's shell beach, Eluanbi's white lighthouse, and the Pacific grasslands of Longpan Park.
